Our Partnership Approach

We work alongside you to create tailored programs, like health coaching to lower A1c, reminders for diabetic retinopathy screening, and customized interventions for diverse diabetic sub-populations, so outreach is both culturally relevant and clinically effective.

We use AI-driven categorization to analyze patient messages and surface trends, needs, and opportunities. We work with you to design programs that directly support your ACO, CIN, or payer contract objectives, whether that’s reducing avoidable ED visits, achieving quality incentive targets, or aligning with value-based utilization goals. Our approach shows the tangible role patient engagement technology plays in improving outcomes and lowering costs.

State & Primary Care Associations

We work with state and primary care associations (PCAs) to implement statewide solutions and approaches that directly impact the health of entire regions. Health happens outside the clinic walls. We are proud to partner with community-based organizations that provide the essential resources people need to thrive.

CareMessage is the technology non-profit building the largest patient engagement platform for low-income populations in the United States.
Our solutions are designed to help Federally Qualified Health Centers thrive in value-based care, meet UDS and HEDIS measures, and improve population health outcomes for the communities you serve.

You need a partner who understands the pressure of UDS reporting, the importance of HEDIS measures, and the constant drive to do more with limited resources. You need a solution built not just for healthcare, but for your model of healthcare.

For over a decade, CareMessage has worked hand-in-hand with FQHCs. Our non-profit mission is aligned with yours, and our technology is purpose-built to help you meet your goals and achieve your mission.
"I appreciate Care Messages’ commitment to underserved communities by using evidenced based engagement tools to improve a patient’s access to quality healthcare."

Closing care gaps for UDS, HEDIS, and other quality measures is a constant challenge. Our platform automates the crucial outreach needed to improve your performance. From driving cancer screenings and immunizations to helping patients control their A1c, we provide the tools to systematically improve your metrics and secure the funding you depend on.

Success in value-based care requires proactive, consistent patient engagement that goes beyond the clinic walls. Our platform is the engine for your VBC strategy, enabling you to manage chronic conditions, reduce costly no-shows, improve care coordination, and address the social drivers of health that have a huge impact on total cost of care.

Your quality and population health teams are heroic, but they are often buried in spreadsheets and manual workflows. CareMessage is their force multiplier. We transform a time-consuming, manual process into an automated, strategic one, freeing your team from chasing down patient lists so they can focus on high-impact initiatives and complex patient needs.

As a fellow 501(c)(3) non-profit, we share your commitment to impact over profit. We understand the financial and operational realities of FQHCs and have designed our platform and pricing to be a sustainable, long-term partner in your success.
Deep Expertise & Proven Results

We have over a decade of experience working specifically with FQHCs. Our platform is not a generic healthcare tool; it’s a refined solution built on clinically-proven strategies and a deep understanding of your unique workflows, reporting needs, and patient populations.

We don't just work with individual health centers; we partner with the entire FQHC ecosystem. We collaborate closely with Primary Care Associations (PCAs) and Health Center Controlled Networks (HCCNs) to drive change at a systemic level and ensure our solutions are aligned with the broader needs of the community health movement.
